comments.body:
Quest: The Missing Man(?) I'm not sure if this is the exact name of the quest because I turned it in without really paying attention to the name by mistake, but I remember it as this.

Obtained in St. Petersburg Adventure Guild

Requirements: Nordic language (I don't have Nordic but it popped for me anyway)

Guide: Go to the church in Stockholm and talk to the boy. Some dialogue will appear. Just like with your nation's story or quests like the Tenochtitlan quests, you will also be asked questions which you will be given two or three answers to choose from.

Then, go to the bar. More dialogue.

Next is the Lubeck church. Initiate dialogue.

After that, go to the hamburg church. Talk to the boy again.

Next, talk to the boy again, this time outside of the bar in hamburg.

Lastly, go back to Stockholm and talk to the boy, which will be located outside of the harbor port.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: So, there are Astronomical discoveries "in the wild", and their availability is related to World Clock periods and Adept of Age titles. If I discovered one, then reported it to Galileo in Pisa, could I then find the same "wild" discovery again, like with archive map discoveries? Or would I have to actually lose the discovery card first before I could "find" it again?

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Non-astronomer's uneducated guess: these wild discoveries would probably work the same way fishing discoveries that are also wild. What happens with those? For sure you can't rediscover the same fish again if you have the card, and I don't know what happens when you loose the card? I don't think I've ever managed to loose a fishing card, I wonder if it's even possible at all?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Egw's guess lines up with my own findings. Otherwise, all you'd have to do is find an Astronomical discovery in the same sea zone as a town with a discovery reporting NPC in it, and then discover/report/discover/report, over and over, until your Astronomy skill was maxed. As for losing cards, Treasure Hunt synthesis, Lima/Caribbean/SEA City Official donations, and losing in Debate Tournaments are the only way to lose them apart from ornament creation... it ought to be possible for fish and Astronomy cards to be lost, under those conditions. But it still wouldn't be possible to do it more once every blue moon.

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Yes, I think you will have to lose the card in order to be able to redo the discovery.

That would be in line with fishing and shipwreck discoveries. You can only get those again after losing the card. I confirmed this for fish and shipwreck discoveries, but I haven't lost an astronomy card so far.
